recentItems.title: The Riot | Official Trailer | Netflix
recentItems.description:
December 1989, Poland. Everyone is celebrating freedom and change.
Everyone except those behind bars. For them, change is only a promise, and hope turns out to be the most dangerous weapon of all. Because when you take it away, a riot is born. The same riot that will put two former cellmates on opposite sides of the bars, trying to prevent a massacre. A series inspired by the true story of the largest prison protests in Polish history.

THE RIOT. Borys Szyc, Filip Pławiak. December 9, only on Netflix.
